Dated this the 10th day of January, 2025 Sekharan . C vs Easwari on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94935709/
1  ORDER
This is an application filed by the appellants praying for condoning the delay of 111 days in filing the appeal.
2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
3. The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 111 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioners will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE SMA 10-01-2025 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Sekharan . C vs Easwari on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94935709/
